$comment: Written by the agent-setup skill. Every hook in this directory reads this file; the hook scripts themselves need no editing.

bannedCommands.reason: This repo is pnpm (packageManager pnpm@11.9.0, and every CI job uses it). Run the pnpm equivalent.

Use `pnpm exec` instead. npx fetches a package from the registry when the local install is broken, so the run dies on a missing dependency rather than on the install that actually failed — see the comment in .github/workflows/infra.yml.

Infrastructure is deployed only by the Infrastructure workflow (.github/workflows/infra.yml), which assumes the OIDC role and passes the context values the stacks need. `cdk diff` and `cdk synth` locally are fine.
Uploading to the site bucket by hand skips the two-pass ordering in deploy.yml (immutable assets first, then HTML) and the CloudFront invalidation. Deploy through the workflow.

pairedPaths.name: content model
pairedPaths.reminder: src/lib/content-model.ts is the shared vocabulary: migrations/definitions/*.ts and src/lib/contentful-map.ts both read from it. Check whether this change needs a matching migration in migrations/definitions/, and remember Contentful validates on write — an entry published before a new rule is never revisited, so a build-time guard is usually needed too.

pairedPaths.name: migration
pairedPaths.reminder: Migrations declare desired state against the ids and limits in src/lib/content-model.ts — never a bare string literal. If this adds or renames a field, src/lib/content-types.ts and src/lib/contentful-map.ts need the other half, and src/lib/fallback-content.ts must still satisfy the type.

pairedPaths.name: site stack
pairedPaths.reminder: infra/README.md records why the choices in this stack exist (price class, real-404 behaviour, OIDC provider import, role-name suffixes). Read it before changing them. A CSP change here also constrains astro.config.mjs — both deployed environments send script-src 'self' with no 'unsafe-inline', which is why assetsInlineLimit is 0.

sessionNote: Two pnpm projects: the site at the root and the CDK app in infra/ (own lockfile, own tsconfig). Install and run each from its own directory.
